meta.note: Visual system for BetterMate: the web UI (Preact, Tailwind 4) and the 480 px round LVGL display. Token names continue v1 so scripts/design/gen_web_assets.py and gen_display_assets.py keep their inputs; on-ink, primary-text and track are new.
meta.changes: 2026-11-16, after the review against Stacks. Added: control-hover, ink-hover, danger-soft-hover, state-hover, the button-lg style, mark, dialog and the layer family. Changed: primary-hover in Dark, flow, series-pressure. Deprecated: disabled. Nothing was removed or renamed.

tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: The ground: the web page and the whole face of the round display. Everything else sits on it.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Tiles: every bento tile, the sidebar, the mode bar, and cards on the display (profile facts, warning rows). One tone step above surface-0; that step is the elevation, never a shadow.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Controls and cells inside a tile: inputs, the segmented track, stepper discs, nested stat cells, menus, the display's minus and plus discs. Never place a primary fill on it in Dark (2.6:1).

tokens.name: control-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of a surface-2 control: the default button and a stepper disc. One tone step from rest and distinct from all three surfaces; ink on it reads 8.5:1 or better.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between list rows and around the floating mode bar. Decorative (below 3:1): never the only sign of a state and never the edge of a control you type in.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders and tracks that carry meaning: every input, select and textarea, a menu's edge, the outline button, an unchecked switch track. Holds 3:1 on surface-0, surface-1 and surface-2 in every theme (3.7:1 at worst).

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: The unlit state of every segmented mark: ring ticks, segment bars, dot matrices, phase bars. Decorative by design; the lit segments carry the value.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, icons and numerals on surface-0, surface-1 and surface-2 (11:1 or better everywhere). Also the fill of a selected segment, a checked switch, the ink button and the target notch on a ring.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an ink fill: the selected segment, the active mode, the STOP action.

tokens.name: ink-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of an ink control: the ink button and the STOP banner. on-ink on it reads 13:1 or better. A selected segment or mode is already chosen and has no hover.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on any surface: eyebrows, units, help text, placeholders, inactive nav and mode items (6:1 or better in every theme).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Text that is switched off: a disabled label, a locked mode, the greyed standby ring and the AMOLED rest clock. 3.5:1 or better on every surface and at least APCA Lc 30 on the web's surfaces, the floor for disabled text. Never body copy and never a placeholder.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Cobalt, the one action colour: the action banner, the primary button, the display's START pill, and the pressure ticks. As a fill it sits on surface-0 or surface-1 only (3:1 or better there in every theme).

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of a primary fill on the web. One tone step darker in every theme, so on-primary gains contrast: 11.1:1 in Light, 6.1:1 in Dark. In Dark the hovered fill itself is 2.3:1 on surface-1; its label identifies it.

tokens.name: primary-text
tokens.usage: Cobalt as text or a thin line: links, the focus ring, a field's selected text. 6.5:1 or better on every surface in every theme.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind primary-text: an info chip, a selected profile tile. primary-text on it reads 6.5:1 or better.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill (8.6:1 in Light, 4.6:1 in Dark and AMOLED).

tokens.name: heat
tokens.usage: Orange means the boiler and nothing else: temperature ticks, the temperature series, the heater meter. A mark, 3:1 or better on every surface; as small text use heat-text.

tokens.name: heat-text
tokens.usage: Heat as words: HEATING TO 93°, a live temperature that is off target. 5.4:1 or better on every surface and on heat-soft.

tokens.name: heat-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind heat-text: the HEATING chip, a tile while its boiler is heating, the dim phase of the heating pulse.

tokens.name: on-heat
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a heat fill (4.9:1 or better).

tokens.name: flow
tokens.usage: The flow series in charts and its segment bar. A mark; pair it with the word Flow. Its lightness sits 1.28:1 or more from the series beside it in every theme.

tokens.name: weight
tokens.usage: The weight series in charts and its segment bar: a neutral grey so it never competes with pressure or temperature.

tokens.name: series-pressure
tokens.usage: Pressure line in charts and replays: solid, 2.5 px. Draw charts on surface-0 or surface-1 only, where it holds 3:1.

tokens.name: series-temperature
tokens.usage: Temperature line in charts and replays: solid, 2 px.

tokens.name: series-flow
tokens.usage: Flow line in charts and replays: dashed 6 4, 2 px.

tokens.name: series-weight
tokens.usage: Weight line in charts and replays: dotted 1 5 with round caps, 2 px.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart grid lines and axes.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: The word READY or CONNECTED in a chip, and its dot. Text, 5.5:1 or better on every surface and on success-soft.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a success chip.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Amber, for warnings only (flush recommended, water low): chip text and the warning glyph at 12 o'clock on the display. Never orange, which is reserved for heat.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a warning chip or row.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions: chip text, the delete button label. 4.5:1 or better on every surface and on danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of an error chip, an error notice and the destructive button.

tokens.name: danger-soft-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of the destructive button. danger on it still reads 4.6:1 or better.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The keyboard focus ring on the web: 2px solid, 2px outside the control, on every surface (6.5:1 or better against each).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind a web dialog or sheet. Never on the display: a translucent layer redraws the whole panel.

tokens.name: state-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of a control with no fill of its own: ghost and outline buttons, segmented and mode bar items, nav items, list rows, menu items. A translucent ink, about one tone step on any surface; set the label in ink while it shows.

families.mono: "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The one page title: Profiles, Shot history, Settings.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Tile titles on desktop and the selected profile's name.

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: Tile titles on phones; group titles in Settings.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Copy, text typed into a field, list row titles (at 500), nav items (at 500).

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Stops at 36 g, or after 30 s.
styles.usage: Help text and descriptions under a field or title.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form field labels, segmented items and standalone links, sentence case.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, footnotes, a field's character count, and the word under a mode icon (at 500).

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: UPPERCASE label above a reading, a chart or a tile.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: UPPERCASE label on every button.

styles.name: button-lg
styles.usage: UPPERCASE label on the action banner and on the 56 px pinned button.

styles.name: chip
styles.usage: UPPERCASE status word in a Chip; phase names under a StageTrack.

styles.name: unit
styles.usage: The unit raised beside a large numeral.

styles.name: metric-sm
styles.usage: A target after a reading, values in list rows.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Table numbers, axis ticks and end labels, shot facts in a row, the target after a compact reading.

styles.name: metric-xl
styles.usage: The one reading in the centre of the web dial. Tabular figures.

styles.name: metric-lg
styles.usage: The numeral of a StatTile. Tabular figures.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: Stepper values and compact stat cells. Tabular figures.

styles.name: screen-hero
styles.usage: The one large reading of a display screen: temperature, clock, shot timer. Readable from across the kitchen.

styles.name: screen-hero-sm
styles.usage: The reading between the minus and plus discs: steam target, grind target, the adjusted value.

styles.name: screen-value
styles.usage: Second-rank readings: live pressure and weight during a shot, the live temperature above a target, a profile name.

styles.name: screen-title
styles.usage: A profile name under the reading, sheet, fault and list titles.

styles.name: screen-body
styles.usage: Status sentences and list rows.

styles.name: screen-label
styles.usage: UPPERCASE mode name, unit and state. The smallest text on the display.

styles.name: screen-button
styles.usage: UPPERCASE label on a display pill.

spacing.note: A 4 px grid. 8 between tiles on phones, 12 on desktop; 20 inside a tile.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside a chip; the gap between segments of a bar.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between tiles on a phone; between a title and its help text.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between tiles on desktop; between a tile's head and its body.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter on a phone; padding of a cell.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Padding of every tile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop; gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above a page title; between the wordmark and the first nav item.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Diameter of a list row's icon disc.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between major page sections on desktop.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Bottom padding of a page, so the last tile clears the floating mode bar.

radius.note: Containers are rounded, controls are pills. A nested corner is the outer radius minus the padding between them: tile 28, cell 20, chip 8.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips and tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, nav items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cells inside a tile; cards on the display.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Every tile and the action banner.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Every button, the segmented control, the mode bar, switches, the display's pills.

shadow.note: There are no shadows, blurs or gradients. Depth is one tone step per layer.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: The only shadow value.

size.note: Control heights and fixed dimensions. Touch targets are 44 px on the web and 56 px on the display.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons in dense desktop rows. Fine pointers only: on a touch screen the same button is control-md tall.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button, input, stepper disc, nav item.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: The pinned action at the bottom of a form.

tokens.name: banner
tokens.usage: Minimum height of the action banner.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Every icon on the web.

tokens.name: icon-display
tokens.usage: Icons inside the display's mode discs; 28px in its small discs and at 12 o'clock.

tokens.name: sidebar
tokens.usage: Desktop sidebar width.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the page content.

tokens.name: dialog
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a dialog, a toast and a notice that floats.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area of any web control. A control drawn smaller (a segmented item, the switch, a standalone link) extends its hit area to this.

tokens.name: mark
tokens.usage: Thickness of a drawn mark off the ring: the widest a segment gets, the height of a phase bar, a status dot.

tokens.name: display
tokens.usage: Diameter of the round display.

tokens.name: display-content
tokens.usage: Diameter of the content circle: everything except the ring stays inside it.

tokens.name: display-square
tokens.usage: The inscribed square where two-line text is safe from the curve.

tokens.name: display-touch
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area on the display; minus and plus discs are 60px.

tokens.name: display-action
tokens.usage: Height of the display's action pill.

ring.note: The tick ring, in display pixels from the centre of the 480 px panel. The web dial is the same drawing scaled down.

tokens.name: ring-inner
tokens.usage: Inner end of a tick.

tokens.name: ring-outer
tokens.usage: Outer end of a tick, 6px inside the panel edge.

tokens.name: ring-notch
tokens.usage: Inner end of the target notch: 8px longer than a tick, in ink.

tokens.name: ring-tick
tokens.usage: Stroke of a tick, round capped.

tokens.name: ring-pitch
tokens.usage: Degrees between ticks: 36 ticks on each 140 degree half, 76 on the 300 degree single ring.

border.note: Borders are 1 px hairlines; 2 px only for focus.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers, resting inputs, the outline button, the mode bar's edge.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: The focus ring.

tokens.name: disabled
tokens.usage: Deprecated on 2026-11-16: fading a control took its label under the contrast floor. A disabled web control is now a surface-2 fill with an ink-faint label and no hover. Kept so older code still resolves it; do not use it in new work. On the display a control that cannot be used is hidden instead.

layer.note: The web's stacking order. Nothing floats on the display: a sheet there is a screen.

tokens.name: layer-modebar
tokens.usage: The floating mode bar and a pinned form action.

tokens.name: layer-menu
tokens.usage: Menus, select lists and tooltips.

tokens.name: layer-scrim
tokens.usage: The scrim behind a dialog or sheet.

tokens.name: layer-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and sheets.

tokens.name: layer-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts, above everything.

duration.note: Web only. The display counts frames, not milliseconds.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Colour and fill changes on hover, press and selection; anything leaving.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: A sheet, menu or toast entering; the switch knob; the selected pill moving.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: The dial's ticks catching up after the page loads. Nothing else.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Everything entering or responding to a tap.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Everything leaving.

frame.note: Display motion is counted in panel scans. The LilyGo T-RGB scans 23.5 times a second, so one frame is 42.5 ms.

tokens.name: frame-tick
tokens.usage: One ring tick, one press state, one digit change.

tokens.name: frame-micro
tokens.usage: A label or value stepping in by recolour (about 128 ms).

tokens.name: frame-state
tokens.usage: A state change settling: notch move, phase bar, pill swap (about 213 ms).

tokens.name: frame-page
tokens.usage: A screen change, staggered across its parts (about 340 ms).

tokens.name: frame-sweep
tokens.usage: The longest motion allowed: a ring filling from empty (about 510 ms).
